primitives.instructional_job: Expose the source-recorded observable evidence before a chemical claim or classification.
primitives.attention_target: What was actually observed or stated at the macroscopic level.
primitives.learner_action: Point to the decisive observation before making a claim.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Macroscopic observation view showing only source-recorded evidence.

primitives.instructional_job: Make a source-authorized particle representation inspectable without implying extra microscopic facts.
primitives.attention_target: Particle identity and count/composition encoded by the declared school-level model.
primitives.learner_action: Match particle identities and counts to the symbolic representation.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Particle model with composition and count taken only from source semantic data.

primitives.instructional_job: Connect macroscopic wording or observation to particle and symbolic representations while preserving identity.
primitives.attention_target: Which chemical entity remains the same across representation levels.
primitives.learner_action: Trace the same entity through macro, particle and symbolic panels.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Three-level bridge from macroscopic evidence through particle model to symbolic notation.

primitives.instructional_job: Separate element symbol, coefficient, subscript and ionic charge by position and meaning.
primitives.attention_target: Notation position and its local chemical meaning.
primitives.learner_action: Identify each notation feature before interpreting the formula.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Annotated chemical formula with symbol, coefficient, subscript and charge distinguished.

primitives.instructional_job: Prevent ionic charge from being read as a subscript by holding symbols constant and changing only notation position.
primitives.attention_target: Superscript charge versus lower subscript.
primitives.learner_action: Compare two cases and state what the numeral means in each position.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Two-case contrast distinguishing superscript ionic charge from subscript.

primitives.instructional_job: Distinguish a leading coefficient from a formula subscript without changing unrelated notation.
primitives.attention_target: Whole-species count versus within-species atom count notation.
primitives.learner_action: Compare the two notation positions and name the quantity each changes.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Two-case contrast distinguishing coefficient from subscript.

primitives.instructional_job: Externalize the required conservation bookkeeping instead of leaving it implicit.
primitives.attention_target: Before/after counts for the exact invariant required by the reasoning route.
primitives.learner_action: Fill or compare the required ledger and locate the first mismatch.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Conservation ledger showing the required before-and-after bookkeeping.

primitives.instructional_job: Track the same species from reactants to products before naming roles.
primitives.attention_target: Species identity and change/no-change across the reaction.
primitives.learner_action: Connect corresponding species and mark changed versus unchanged.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Before-and-after species map linking reactants and products.

primitives.instructional_job: Separate reacting/changing species, spectator information, products and named roles using equation evidence.
primitives.attention_target: Which reactant species carries the evidence for the requested role.
primitives.learner_action: Attach a role only after identifying the changing reactant species.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Species role map separating changing reactants, spectators and products.

primitives.instructional_job: Show the order in which a source-authorized default rule and its condition/exception gate are consulted.
primitives.attention_target: Rule selection before condition/exception decision.
primitives.learner_action: Follow the ladder and stop at the first decisive condition or exception.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Rule-priority ladder with the source-authorized condition or exception gate.

primitives.instructional_job: Make the condition or exception that changes rule validity visibly unavoidable.
primitives.attention_target: The single condition/exception that controls applicability.
primitives.learner_action: Answer the gate question before applying the rule or rewriting the reaction.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Decision gate showing when a default rule applies and when a condition or exception overrides it.

primitives.instructional_job: Preserve and label site identity when the chemical reasoning is structure-sensitive.
primitives.attention_target: The specific atom/site to which the rule or property applies.
primitives.learner_action: Locate and track the labelled site rather than using a whole-formula shortcut.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Structural formula with stable site labels and the target site highlighted semantically.

primitives.instructional_job: Show before-to-after oxidation-state direction without giving away an agent label.
primitives.attention_target: Numerical oxidation-state change of the same tracked element.
primitives.learner_action: Compare the two oxidation-state values and state increase or decrease.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Oxidation-state lane linking before and after values for the same element.

primitives.instructional_job: Separate what an agent itself undergoes from what it causes in the other species.
primitives.attention_target: SELF change versus OTHER effect.
primitives.learner_action: Fill SELF first, then OTHER, then attach the agent label.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Two-column SELF/OTHER frame for Redox agent-role reasoning.

primitives.instructional_job: Represent verified split or converge Redox state topology after the same element/state is tracked.
primitives.attention_target: Whether one state splits to two or two states converge to one for the same element.
primitives.learner_action: Label the same element/state on each branch before classifying the topology.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Split/converge state topology for a source-authorized Redox pattern.

primitives.instructional_job: Separate observation, claim and reasoning link so overclaiming is inspectable.
primitives.attention_target: Which evidence supports which part of the claim.
primitives.learner_action: Read observation first, then test each claim against the evidence link.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Observation-to-claim reasoning chain with evidence and inference separated.

primitives.instructional_job: Connect apparatus or method choice to the source-authorized property or observation it uses.
primitives.attention_target: Property → apparatus feature → intended observation or use.
primitives.learner_action: Trace the method choice back to the property/evidence it is meant to exploit.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Apparatus-method flow linking a property to the relevant apparatus feature and intended observation.

primitives.instructional_job: Hold observation and inference in separate cells so one cannot be silently substituted for the other.
primitives.attention_target: Literal evidence versus interpreted chemical claim.
primitives.learner_action: Place each statement in the correct column and justify the inference link.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Two-column table separating observation from inference.

primitives.instructional_job: Hold context constant while changing one decisive chemical feature to expose a wrong model.
primitives.attention_target: The one feature that changes the correct interpretation or decision.
primitives.learner_action: Predict both cases, identify the single difference and revise the model if needed.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Minimal two-case Chemistry contrast differing in exactly one decisive feature.

primitives.instructional_job: Provide a compact independent verification strip using only checks required by the active reasoning route.
primitives.attention_target: Species identity, notation, conservation and condition checks that are actually applicable.
primitives.learner_action: Run each applicable check independently before accepting the result.
primitives.accessibility_pattern: Compact verification strip listing only the checks required by the current Chemistry route.
